states.title: States
states.description: Two-letter state codes to include, e.g. CA, TX, NY. Empty = all US states and territories.

levels.title: Institution level
levels.description: Which levels to include. Empty = all.

controls.title: Ownership
controls.description: Public, private nonprofit, or private for-profit. Empty = all.

openAdmissionOnly.title: Open-admissions only
openAdmissionOnly.description: Keep only schools with an open-admissions policy (accept essentially all applicants with a high-school diploma or equivalent). Best proxy for "I can start soon with low barriers".

onlineOnly.title: Online-only schools
onlineOnly.description: Keep only institutions that deliver programs exclusively via distance education.

testNotRequired.title: Admission test not required
testNotRequired.description: Keep only schools that do not require SAT/ACT scores (test-optional or scores not required). Only applies to schools that report a test policy (~30% of the file); others are dropped when this is on.

offersCredential.title: Offers credential level
offersCredential.description: Keep only schools that offer programs at one or more of these levels. Empty = any.

federalAidOnly.title: Federal student aid participants only
federalAidOnly.description: Keep only schools approved for federal Title IV student aid (Pell grants and federal loans). Note: this is institution-level participation; whether a specific program qualifies for aid is not in the public data.

maxAdmissionRate.title: Max admission rate
maxAdmissionRate.description: Keep only schools whose admission rate is at or below this value, 0-1 (e.g. 0.8 = 80%). Only schools that report an admission rate are kept. Empty = no limit.

keyword.title: Name contains
keyword.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the institution name, e.g. "community", "tech", "state".

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on institutions returned. Controls total cost. First 2 rows per run are free.
